requirements.name: The dashboard lists notifications from every status, identifying each one

scenarios.name: Notifications of every status appear together, deleted ones excluded

tests.test: shows notifications from every status with enough to identify the consignment
tests.notes: SUBMITTED/DRAFT/AMEND stub rows all visible by reference and status; soft-deleted stub row asserted absent

requirements.name: Opening a notification's link routes by its status

tests.test: opening a submitted notification links into the read-only notification-view page

scenarios.name: A draft notification opens its journey hub, not the read-only view

tests.test: opening a draft notification links back to the journey hub, not notification-view

requirements.name: The dashboard can be searched by notification reference

scenarios.name: Searching by complete reference returns only that notification

tests.test: searching by complete reference returns only the matching notification

scenarios.name: A reference that matches nothing shows an empty-result message

tests.test: no matching notification shows "No notifications found"

requirements.name: The dashboard paginates by the address book's rule, every link keeping the sort

scenarios.name: A middle page of many keeps the sort in every pagination link

tests.test: a middle page of many shows Previous, the first, neighbouring and last page links with an ellipsis for each gap, and Next, every link keeping the sort
tests.notes: red-probed: fails when every page is listed, and when Previous or Next drops the sort; asserts rendered items, current page, every page href and the Previous and Next hrefs
